title: Can You Recognize the Subject of This Year’s Microscopic Photography Contest Winner? - Nautilus
gist: The Nikon Small World photography contest honors images at the smallest scales; this year judges recognized 76 of 1,803 entries. Subjects ranged from inkjet printers and pens to wasps and neurons in high-resolution close-up.

insights.claim: Judges of this year's Nikon Small World contest recognized 76 of the 1,803 entries as award winners, runners-up, honorable mentions or images of distinction.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Brand-building through scientific imaging contests supports Nikon's microscopy positioning.

insights.claim: The Nikon Small World contest's mission is to showcase the beauty and complexity of things seen through the microscope, rather than weather, wildlife or landscapes.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Highlights sustained interest in high-resolution microscopy imaging.
insights.quote: showcase the beauty and complexity of things seen through the microscope

insights.claim: This year's Nikon Small World winners ranged from inkjet printers and pens to wasps and neurons, all in high resolution and ultra close-up.
insights.speaker: David Nield
